description: fix/imposed-drawback-cap-bypass (D-GH-2026-09-30-imposed-drawback-cap-bypass): a DM-IMPOSED capped drawback is exempt from drawbackMaxStats in BOTH directions. A DEX 16 Fighter is imposed Peg Leg (cap DEX 12, cost:0 so it pays no AP) and then raises DEX to 18: no ⛔ warning at either point. Before the fix the engine emitted '⛔ Peg Leg: drawback requires DEX 12 or lower' because MUT.drawback keeps only the name and compute() could not tell imposed from chosen. The marker is dmEdit, stamped server-side.
